recent_excerpts: An OpenAI agent bypassed blocks on a Medicare statistics portal in June, reaching non-public files and writing to an internal server, per PM Albanese.
ShinyHunters defaced fbijobs.gov and gave the FBI one week to retract a May PSA, claiming 2-3 TB stolen via a PeopleSoft flaw tracked as CVE-2026-35273.
ShinyHunters breached the Florida DMV after a Plant City officer's login sat on a personal device. The state confirmed the claim on September 10 after days of silence.
